notes.en-US: Clearer calendar amounts with standard numbers and compact large-value units. Larger daily changes now use deeper colors in light and dark mode. Calendar columns align to keep amounts fully visible.
notes.zh-Hans: 简化每日变动金额，万以内直接显示数字；修正为变动越大颜色越深，并让矩阵方格整列对齐。
notes.zh-Hant: 簡化每日變動金額，萬以內直接顯示數字；修正為變動越大顏色越深，並讓矩陣方格整列對齊。
